//: As registry.ts: @anclient/* are linked to the sources of this Anclient checkout (anreact 0.8, React 19, MUI 9). npm doesn't install the dependencies of linked sources, so they are listed here: React, MUI, emotion and tss-react for anreact, js-sha256 for semantier. semantic-doc (the doc-tree editor, until it moves into anreact) is installed from its tarball, packed by `npm run pack` (or build) in github/semantic-doc/src; npm installs its dependencies (Tiptap). After packing a new one, run `npm run install-sdoc` here. KaTeX is listed for the page's katex.min.css. Build tools (babel, ...) come from ../node_modules.
